logline: A mismatched gang of strangers unite to scam a corrupt and superstitious UP politician - a heist comedy that plays its ensemble cast like a game of chess.

bollymeter.basis: 43% on Rotten Tomatoes (7 critics). Critics praised the ensemble chemistry and Jimmy Shergill's turn as the villain but found the pacing uneven in the middle stretch.

seasons.review_body: Choona arrived on Netflix in September 2023 with a strong ensemble cast and a premise tailor-made for the heist-comedy genre: misfits vs. a superstitious corrupt politician. Director Pushpendra Nath Misra assembled veterans Jimmy Shergill and Aashim Gulati alongside a tight ensemble, with Arshad Warsi narrating. The 43% Rotten Tomatoes score from 7 critics reflected a divided reception - reviewers who leaned into the Bollywood-inflected absurdism found it charming, while others found the mid-series momentum thin. Shergill as the villain Avinash Shukla emerged as the clear standout, playing superstition-driven menace with visible relish. The show works best in its ensemble scenes, where the heist planning crackles with comic energy.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere does its job efficiently: establishing the villain's particular brand of superstitious corruption and assembling the gang one character at a time.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Avinash Shukla's introduction - the moment viewers understand exactly what kind of villain Shergill has decided to play.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 8
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale delivers on the heist's promise with enough twists to justify the buildup, even if some beats feel telegraphed.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The con's final turn, where the superstition angle pays off in the most satisfying way the show has engineered.
